mechanisms.name: precipitation strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: heat-treated (homogenized 1473 K/0.5 h + aged 1073 K/5 h)

evidence.quote: the precipitate refinement caused by decreased lattice misfit with increasing vanadium concentration results in the enhanced compressive yield strength at 973 K.

mechanisms.name: precipitate refinement by reduced lattice misfit
mechanisms.material_state: heat-treated (homogenized 1473 K/0.5 h + aged 1073 K/5 h)

evidence.quote: we believe that the reduced lattice misfit between matrix and precipitate promotes a reduction of critical nucleation radius according to classical nucleation theory, hence it leads to the refinement of the precipitates.

mechanisms.name: solid-solution strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: heat-treated (homogenized 1473 K/0.5 h + aged 1073 K/5 h)
